description: OrgSync steering (B1) and capture (B2). Steering matches prompts, replies and written text with the company's decision titles on this computer and adds at most one factual line. Capture links the session's transcript into a private folder at PreCompact and SessionEnd and starts a background worker that proposes items for the person's private queue; nothing is captured off the record. Every hook but the courier's check exits at once inside a capture worker's own run.

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "$ORGSYNC_CAPTURE_CHILD" ] && exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/codex/steer.mjs" SessionStart'
hooks.statusMessage: OrgSync: check this session against company decisions

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "$ORGSYNC_CAPTURE_CHILD" ] && exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/codex/steer.mjs" UserPromptSubmit'
hooks.statusMessage: OrgSync: check your message against company decisions

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "$ORGSYNC_CAPTURE_MANIFEST" ] || exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "OrgSync capture: refused, no manifest check" >&2; exit 2; }; exec node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/worker/courier.mjs" check'
hooks.statusMessage: OrgSync: check a capture worker's draft before it is sent

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "$ORGSYNC_CAPTURE_CHILD" ] && exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/codex/steer.mjs" PostToolUse'
hooks.statusMessage: OrgSync: check written text against company decisions

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "$ORGSYNC_CAPTURE_CHILD" ] && exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/codex/steer.mjs" PostToolUse'
hooks.statusMessage: OrgSync: learn decision titles from OrgSync results

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "$ORGSYNC_CAPTURE_CHILD" ] && exit 0; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/codex/steer.mjs" Stop'
hooks.statusMessage: OrgSync: check the reply against company decisions
OrgSync: decision capture before compacting (off unless turned on)
OrgSync: decision capture at session end (off unless turned on)
